subject: general
question: If in a certain code language ‘GAME’ is written as ‘0720012613140522’, then how will ‘NOT’ be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/130e026a7c3720f6f9db70163ea219cbcf01f13f419b49f6b5b6c1ad7f909510.png] 

The logic follows here is:

**The positional value of the letter is written then the positional value of its reverse letter is written.**

 
• **‘GAME’ is written as ‘0720012613140522’**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7928b1ef26c98a427ff9e3669f43c06ffda1321cf60421b5bc5895d21d58aad.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• **‘NOT’ will be coded as:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a28ff7a05a054a3f89a52ec696f6f901cf53c9f362a255fea7785c38b1f8f148.png] 

Thus the code for 'NOT' will be "141315122007".

Hence, the correct answer is "**141315122007**".
